preconditions.description: There is at least one test case in the input.

preconditions.expression: all(line.strip().isdigit() or all(c in 'VK?' for c in line.strip()) for line in stdin.split('\n') if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Each test case consists of an integer n followed by a string of length n with characters 'V', 'K', or '?'.

preconditions.expression: sum(int(stdin.split('\n')[i].strip()) for i in range(1, len(stdin.split('\n')), 3)) <= 500000
preconditions.description: The sum of lengths among all test cases does not exceed 5·10^5.

postconditions.description: The number of periods in the output matches the specified count for each test case.

postconditions.expression:
all(all(int(p) >= 1 and int(p) <= int(stdin.split('
')[3*i+1].strip()) for p in output.split('
')[2*i+1].split()) for i in range(len(output.split('
'))//2))
postconditions.description: Each period is between 1 and the length of the corresponding string.

postconditions.expression:
all(all(output.split('
')[2*i+1].split()[j] <= output.split('
')[2*i+1].split()[j+1] for j in range(len(output.split('
')[2*i+1].split())-1)) for i in range(len(output.split('
'))//2))
postconditions.description: Periods are listed in increasing order for each test case.
